definitions.gloss: fine words; idealistic talk that ignores reality; whitewash
definitions.explanation: Talk that sounds good or high-minded but ignores the unpleasant facts, or a presentation that hides them.

examples.japanese: {綺麗事|きれいごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綺麗事|きれいごと}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。

{綺麗事|きれいごと}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The president said you can't run a company on fine words alone.

notes:
Almost always critical: the speaker means the other person is not facing reality. Also written ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧{事|ごと} or きれいごと.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綺麗事|きれいごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to talk idealistically
- {綺麗事|きれいごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{済|す}まない→済む：01950_sumu⟧: fine words won't settle it
- {綺麗事|きれいごと}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: frankly, without the nice words

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建前|たてまえ}→建前：06621_tatemae⟧: the official stance one presents; {綺麗事|きれいごと} is the criticism that such talk is unrealistic
- ⟦{口先|くちさき}→口先：16728_kuchisaki⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: all talk and no action
